title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
July 15, 2025

Via Electronic Filing

Scott S. Harris
Clerk of the Court
Supreme Court of the United States
1 First Street, N.E.
Washington, DC 20543-0001

Re: Enbridge Energy, LP et al. v. Dana Nessel, Attorney General of Michigan, on Behalf of
the People of the State of Michigan
 No. 24-783

Dear Mr. Harris:

I represent Petitioners in the above-captioned case.  Having conferred with Respondent’s
counsel, we write jointly to request that the Court enter the following briefing schedule:

Petitioners’ brief and joint appendix:  August 29, 2025

Respondent’s brief:  October 14, 2025

Petitioners’ reply:  November 13, 2025

These extensions of time are requested to accommodate professional and personal obligations
during the briefing period.  Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,



Alice E. Loughran
Counsel for Petitioners

cc: All Counsel of Record
